measuredSpectrum.source: Burnashev (1985), Abastumani Astrophys. Obs. Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 617 (BS 1845, CE Tau, Crimean scan of 1982-10-24)

gaps.reason: the Crimean scan ends at 772.5 nm; the last value is held to 780 nm, where the observer adds almost nothing

measuredSpectrum.note: Ground-based photoelectric scan of 1982-10-24, 327.5-772.5 nm in 2.5 nm steps, published as log10 flux. The second Crimean scan, record 647 of 1983-02-02, gives a paler colour (#ffb859); CE Tau is a semi-regular variable.

crossCheck.source: Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 3400796031719045632 (G = 3.1, likely saturated)
crossCheck.disagreement: Gaia XP gives a paler colour (#ffbe5f), and so does the second Crimean night (record 647, #ffb859); CE Tau is a semi-regular variable and Gaia XP is unreliable this bright, so which colour is typical is not settled.
